radio-group

Single-item selector, which consists of multiple radio components.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
bindchange eventHandle No The change event is triggered when the selected item in the radio-group changes. The output is detail = {value:[Array of the selected radio value]}.

Sample Code


<view>
  <view>
    <radio-group bindchange='radioChange'>
      <label ma:for='{{items}}' ma:key='{{item.value}}'>
        <view>
          <radio value='{{item.value}}' checked='{{item.checked}}' color='pink' />
        </view>
        <view>{{item.name}}</view>
      </label>
    </radio-group>
  </view>
</view>

Page({
  data: {
    items: [
      { value: 'USA', name: 'USA' },
      { value: 'CHN', name: 'China', checked: 'true' },
      { value: 'BRA', name: 'Brazil' },
      { value: 'JPN', name: 'Japan' },
      { value: 'ENG', name: 'UK' },
      { value: 'FRA', name: 'France' }
    ]
  },
  radioChange: function(e) {
    console.log(e.detail.value);

    var items = this.data.items;
    for (var i = 0, len = items.length; i < len; ++i) {
      items[i].checked = items[i].value == e.detail.value;
    }

    this.setData({
      items: items
    });
  }
});
